rows.text: How was it, did you get the record

rows.text: I asked Serval for her album, but she doesn't have it, so
Yeah, yeah. Pom-Pom will ask the corporation if we can get it from them. But Pom-Pom cannot guarantee it'll satisfy the taste of all passengers

rows.text: Don't be upset, you're a Trailblazer, an opportunity will come to you eventually
